items.title: Mortal Shell 2 Understands That Bigger Isn’t What Makes an Open World Better
items.description:
Maybe the real appeal of not subscribing to the “bigger is better” philosophy is that Mortal Shell 2 can focus on providing a unique, engaging experience in every aspect that matters. 

Either way, we won't have to wait long to find out since it launches on August 20th for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC. Whether the spirit of FromSoftware courses through, or it turns out to be something else entirely, Mortal Shell 2 certainly has our attention.
